messages.subject: 10X genomics alignment stats
parts:
Dear All,
 I am using 10x reads to do variant calling.
I did alignment using long-ranger and getting a very low amount of properly paired end reads(67.35%).
Here are the statistics.

620420547 + 0 in total (QC-passed reads + QC-failed reads)
40338339 + 0 secondary
0 + 0 supplementary
140710457 + 0 duplicates
598029665 + 0 mapped (96.39% : N/A)
580082208 + 0 paired in sequencing
290041104 + 0 read1
290041104 + 0 read2
390667031 + 0 properly paired (67.35% : N/A)
546825133 + 0 with itself and mate mapped
10866193 + 0 singletons (1.87% : N/A)
92225526 + 0 with mate mapped to a different chr
75482652 + 0 with mate mapped to a different chr (mapQ>=5)

This low percentage of  properly paired end reads(67.35%) is due to the sequencing chemistry of 10x reads or is there any other reason.
I have potato samples.
Is it a good practice to proceed with properly paired end reads for variant calling and ignoring all other reads. (For me its yes as it reduces the chances of false positive SNP calls).

Looking forward for your valuable suggestions.

Best wishes,
Nadia
